tasks.label: Backend: start FastAPI
tasks.command: if (Test-Path .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000 } elseif (Test-Path ..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe) { ..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000 } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000 }

tasks.label: Backend: create test user
tasks.command: if (Test-Path .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\seed_test_user.py } elseif (Test-Path ..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe) { ..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\seed_test_user.py } else { python scripts\seed_test_user.py }
